If u wanna dig deeper into this fun game called life and make a change, comment “shift” and i’ll send you over something i’ve been crafting up. 

i’m sick and tired of people not believing that this actually works
transcript: I just read a study about reverse manifestation and stay with me for 30 seconds because I'm going to blow your mind and I'm going to start manifesting everything into my entire life. Watch me in six months change my life. Essentially, the study said that we have a reticular activating system, RAS, which means whatever we search for in this life, we will find more of. Have you ever had a dream car and all of a sudden you start seeing that car everywhere? That's basically your brain choosing what to filter out because 99% of the things that we see in our lives is filtered out. We only focus on the 1% that our brain subconsciously goes to. Think of your brain as like an algorithm in this sense. The reason why most people think manifesting is a load of horseshit is because they're relying on physical things to make them feel an emotional state, when in reality, it is actually the other way around. The only reason we want the physical thing is to feel the emotional state. Therefore, if you can feel the emotional state currently and consistently, you have a higher likelihood of training your reticular activating system to spot those experiences more. Therefore, literally attracting that physical thing into your reality. This basically means whatever you want to manifest, create a real physical, like tangible object. Say it's a dream dream car get a little mini action figure of your car that you can put in front of you everywhere and train your brain to see it and do things that align with feeling that emotion because the stronger you feel that emotion the stronger your filter will be to feel and crave that emotion even more so step one to reverse manifestation is make it real step two feel the energy that that thing will give you step three don't wait but attract that energy into your reality and the physical thing will be there before you blink
